status.description: pending, paid, shipped, delivered, cancelled, refunding, refunded

age.description: Age is the age of the pet in months

ageDisplay.description: AgeDisplay is a human-readable age string (e.g., "2个月", "1岁")

breed.description: Breed is the specific breed of the pet

createdAt.description: CreatedAt is when the pet was added

description.description: Description is a detailed description of the pet

healthStatus.description: HealthStatus describes the health condition of the pet

id.description: ID is the unique identifier for the pet

name.description: Name is the name of the pet

photoUrls.description: PhotoUrls contains a list of photo URLs for the pet

price.description: Price is the price of the pet in CNY

status.description: Status indicates the availability of the pet (e.g., "available", "pending", "sold")

type.description: Type is the species or breed of the pet (e.g., "Dog", "Cat")
